subject: mathematics

applicable_programme.grade_mapping_note: PYP covers ages 3-12; our Grade 3 mapping (typically age 8-9) is within the programme but is our convention, not an IB-specified grade boundary.

grade_specific_note.label: C
grade_specific_note.text: Grade 3 students in PYP mathematics typically work with place value to 10,000, develop multiplication and division understanding, explore fractions, and apply mathematical thinking to real-world inquiries.

subject_group_or_structure.mapping_to_primer_subject: IB PYP Mathematics encompasses number, pattern and function, data handling, measurement, and shape and space. It emphasizes mathematical reasoning and real-world application through inquiry.

concepts: Causation - Why is it like it is?
Connection - How is it connected to other things?
Perspective - What are the points of view?
global_contexts_or_transdisciplinary_the: Where we are in place and time

official_requirements.label: B
official_requirements.text: PYP Mathematics Scope and Sequence covers five strands: Number, Pattern and Function, Data Handling, Measurement, and Shape and Space.

official_requirements.label: B
official_requirements.text: Mathematical learning is developed through phases, with students moving through constructing meaning, transferring meaning, and applying with understanding.

official_requirements.label: B
official_requirements.text: Mathematics is taught in meaningful contexts, often integrated with units of inquiry, emphasizing real-world application.

typical_fit.label: C
typical_fit.text: At Grade 3, PYP mathematics learners typically: understand place value to thousands, develop multiplication and division concepts, explore fractions as parts of wholes, measure using standard units, and identify geometric properties. These align with Florida B.E.S.T. standards for number sense (MA.3.NSO), fractions (MA.3.FR), and geometry (MA.3.GR).

suggested_alignment_to_florida_and_arizo.label: C

florida.alignment_note: Place value to 10,000 aligns with PYP Number strand's understanding of whole numbers.
Multiplication facts aligns with PYP Pattern and Function strand.
Unit fractions aligns with PYP Number strand's development of fraction understanding.
Area of rectangles aligns with PYP Measurement and Shape and Space strands.
Real-world problems aligns with PYP emphasis on applying mathematics in context.

suggested_alignment_to_florida_and_arizo.notes: Arizona standards deferred. These alignments are suggested starting points (Label C), not official IB-Florida mappings.
